sections.text_helper: Section 2.1.1 "Fast C-bus" in chapter 2 (Memory and bus architecture), RM0522 Rev 1, page 88.
sections.section_content:
This bus connects the C-bus of the Cortex-M33 core to the FLASH and to the bus matrix
through the ICACHE. This bus is used for instruction fetch and data access to the internal
memories mapped in code region. This bus targets the FLASH and the internal SRAMs
(SRAM1/2).
SRAM1 and SRAM2 are accessible on this bus with a continuous mapping.
